headline: RBI issues (Commercial Banks - KYC) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
reference: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
summary_points: RBI has published the Commercial Banks - Know Your Customer Second Amendment Directions, 2026 on its notifications page.
The amendment relates to the KYC Directions applicable to commercial banks.
The text available here shows only the title; the specific amendments, dates and applicability are not visible.
Readers should consult the 238 kb PDF on the RBI website for the actual changes.
who_is_affected: Commercial banks and their customers subject to KYC norms, along with compliance and risk teams handling onboarding and periodic KYC updates.
action_required: Download the full Directions from the RBI website, identify the amended provisions and effective date, and update bank KYC policies and processes accordingly.

RBI has issued the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026.

The Directions amend the existing KYC framework applicable to commercial banks. The notification is available as a PDF on the RBI website.

The page content we reviewed shows only the title, so the specific changes, issue date and effective date are not yet confirmed here. Compliance, risk and operations teams at banks should read the full text to see which provisions have changed and whether onboarding, re-KYC or record-keeping processes need to be revised.

Finance professionals advising banks, NBFC partners and fintech clients on KYC obligations may also want to track how these amendments affect customer due diligence workflows.

Please verify the details with the official RBI source before acting.
